<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blacks(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']>20:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols),n['pixels']))
    return out
action(['UP']*5 + ['LEFT']*3)
print("after:", blacks(current_frame))
